editorial.blurb: David's Grill serves up hearty, affordable American comfort food with generous portions in a casual, booth-filled space that welcomes everyone.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during quieter times to avoid the wait, and skip the homemade chips—reviewers consistently note they taste like they're fried in old oil, though the salsa is solid.

topDishes.note: Can't beat the value—fries and a gyro for under $10
